title: Chipperfield by Spectrum HCS770X Scythe-Bar Mower
description_html:
Chipperfield by Spectrum HCS770X Scythe-Bar Mower

Take on dense, overgrown vegetation that would overwhelm a handheld brushcutter with the Chipperfield by Spectrum HCS770X. This powerful self-propelled scythe-bar mower is built to clear large areas of long grass, weeds, nettles, and brambles quickly and efficiently, making it the ideal choice for landowners, contractors, and grounds maintenance professionals.

Powered by a robust 212cc Rato horizontal-shaft four-stroke petrol engine, the HCS770X combines dependable performance with economical running costs. Featuring an easy-pull recoil starter and fuel-efficient overhead valve (OHV) technology, the engine delivers reliable power while reducing fuel consumption and emissions.

At the front of the machine is a 102cm reciprocating cutter bar fitted with 19 pairs of precision, scissor-action blades with 35mm blade spacing. This proven cutting system slices cleanly through heavy vegetation with ease, providing a level of productivity that conventional brushcutters simply can’t match.

Large 330mm tractor-pattern pneumatic tyres provide excellent grip and stability on rough, uneven ground and slopes, ensuring confident progress across challenging terrain. The self-propelled transmission offers both forward and reverse drive, making manoeuvring straightforward, while the axle pins can be quickly disengaged to place the transmission into neutral, allowing the machine to be pushed manually whenever required.

Operator comfort is equally well considered. The handlebars can be adjusted for height to suit the user, reducing fatigue during prolonged use. They also feature three lateral positions (left, centre and right), allowing you to walk alongside the machine rather than directly behind it. This is particularly useful when working through dense patches of nettles, brambles and other overgrown vegetation, helping to keep you clear of the material being cut.

For added versatility, the HCS770X offers an adjustable cutting height between 30mm and 80mm, allowing you to tailor the finish to suit a wide range of vegetation types and site conditions.

Delivery & Assembly

The Chipperfield by Spectrum HCS770X is supplied boxed for home assembly.

For complete peace of mind, you can choose our optional Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) service, where the machine is fully assembled, inspected, fuelled, started, and tested by our engineers before dispatch.

The mower is then securely delivered on a pallet. Where possible, delivery is carried out using one of our own vehicles, allowing us to provide a brief handover demonstration so you can get started with confidence straight away.
